mapper.select: SELECT ACTION, CREATED_AT FROM KIOSK_LOG WHERE ACTION=#{action}
SELECT HOUR(CREATED_AT) AS PRINT_HOUR , COUNT(*) AS PRINTING_COUNT FROM KIOSK_LOG WHERE ACTION='명찰 발급' GROUP BY HOUR(CREATED_AT) ORDER BY PRINT_HOUR
SELECT ACTION , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM KIOSK_LOG GROUP BY ACTION ORDER BY CNT DESC
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = '출석' THEN 1 END) AS ATTEND, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS <> '출석' THEN 1 END) AS NOT_ATTEND FROM ATTENDANCE
